_comment: Default presence keepalive configuration for the Civil mod.
Each entry names an entity type whose vicinity will receive periodic civilization
presence refresh (getCScoreAt + visitAt), countering natural score decay.
Optional radius_voxel_chunks { "x", "z", "y" } sets half-extents in voxel chunks;
omit the block entirely for built-in defaults 3 / 3 / 1.
Files load in lexicographic order; later files add to the merged set.
Set replace: true on a file to clear all entries from earlier files.
Unknown entity ids are skipped with a warning.
